config/session.php.serialization.message: Laravel 13 serializes sessions as JSON by default; switching invalidates all active sessions. The previous 'php' value was kept.
config/session.php.serialization.action: Change to 'json' during a maintenance window after expiring or migrating active sessions.

config/cache.php.serializable_classes.message: Laravel 13 disables PHP object unserialization from cache by default.
config/cache.php.serializable_classes.action: The previous permissive cache unserialization behavior was kept. Review cached object usage and narrow this value deliberately.
